conversion.from: BEDPE (one row per read pair, 11 columns)
conversion.to: fragment BED (chrom, start, end, mapq, strand), gzipped
conversion.rule: outer coordinates = min(start1, start2) .. max(end1, end2); pairs on two chromosomes are dropped

genome_build.note: The extractor's bin grid uses hg38 chromosome sizes, so the hg38 grid is what the features are computed on -- the same grid the training cohort's features use. Fragments starting past an hg38 chromosome end are dropped by that grid.
genome_build.depositor_statement: The depositor's own data-availability statement says the deposited fragment files are mapped to hg19: 'De-identified fragment files mapped to hg19 and individual summary statistics have been deposited at Zenodo.org' -- Liu et al., Cell Reports Medicine 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10897513/ . The verdict above is measured from the coordinates themselves, so the two agree independently.
